;Armed conflicts and attacks

*[[Fatah–Hamas conflict]]
**The [[Gaza Strip]]'s sole power plant is shut down due to running out of fuel, amid unpaid bills and a [[Governance of the Gaza Strip|dispute]] over tax bills on fuel imports to the [[blockade of the Gaza Strip|blockaded]] [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] territory. ;Arts and culture

;International relations
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[United States Pacific Command|U.S. Pacific Command]] and [[Joint Chiefs of Staff (South Korea)|South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff]] report  that a [[North Korea]]n missile, tested near the city of [[Sinpo]] on  the country's east coast, blew up almost immediately after the launch, just hours before [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] was due in South Korea for talks about the North's arms program. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-04-16/north-korea-attempts-but-fails-to-launch-missile-south-korea-say/8446418 (ABC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-missile-idUSKBN17H0NL (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Shooting of Robert Godwin]]
**[[Cleveland]] police search for a suspect identified in a [[Facebook]] video showing one man shooting an elderly man. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/04/16/524260257/cleveland-police-search-for-suspected-shooter-accused-of-live-streaming-homicide (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Turkish constitutional referendum, 2017]]
**Voters in [[Turkey]] go to the polls for a referendum that seeks to replace the country's [[parliamentary system]] with an [[Executive president|executive presidency]], thereby giving [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] sweeping new powers. Erdoğan's [[AK Party]] has claimed victory while the opposition [[Republican People's Party (Turkey)|CHP]] has said that it will challenge the result. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/turks-to-decide-whether-to-give-erdogan-vastly-increased-powers/2017/04/15/e79812b6-1bda-11e7-bcc2-7d1a0973e7b2_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [http://finance.yahoo.com/news/polls-open-turkeys-historic-referendum-reforms-040917078.html?soc_trk=gcm&soc_src=4c3f3bad-4244-3150-88fa-52995906cc3a&.tsrc=notification-brknews (AP via Yahoo!)]

;Sports
* In [[ice hockey]], [[SKA Saint Petersburg|SKA St. Petersburg]] wins the [[Gagarin Cup]], the championship of the [[Kontinental Hockey League]], with a 5–3 win over [[Metallurg Magnitogorsk]] in Game 5 to win the [[2017 Gagarin Cup playoffs|championship series]] 4–1. [http://www.espn.com/nhl/story/_/id/19177827/pavel-datsyuk-adds-khl-title-stanley-cup-victories (ESPN)]
* in [[rugby union]], [[RGC 1404]] win the Welsh [[WRU Challenge Cup|SWALEC National Cup]] for the first time in their short history. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/rugby-union/39617334 (BBC News)]
